analyzed_vuln.description: Heap UAF is caused by stale header pointers in flow->packet being reused during HTTP extra-packet reprocessing. check_content_type_and_change_protocol calls ndpi_http_check_content(), which memcmp()s packet->content_disposition_line.ptr without ensuring that pointer still refers to live packet storage. In the fuzz harness each packet buffer is malloc'ed, processed, then immediately freed; extra-packet callbacks later run on subsequent packets while flow state still carries line pointers from prior packet parsing, so ndpi_http_check_content reads freed memory.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires a flow that enters HTTP extra packet processing (flow->extra_packets_func = ndpi_search_http_tcp_again), with Content-Disposition parsing path active (content_disposition_line.len/offset conditions reaching memcmp at http.c:149). The harness allocates packet_checked, passes it into ndpi_workflow_process_packet, then frees it after return; if flow-level HTTP parsed-line pointers are retained across packets instead of revalidated/reset, a later extra-packet invocation dereferences a pointer into the previously freed packet buffer, producing UAF in bcmp/memcmp.
